title: Team Canada vs. the Misfits in Action
summary: Lance Storm’s Team Canada turns the United States title into the focus of a national-pride angle. General Rection’s pursuit becomes more personal when Jim Duggan switches sides.

chapters.title: Duggan betrays Rection
chapters.result: Storm retains the United States title with Duggan’s help.
chapters.context: The veteran associated with American patriotism joins Team Canada, reversing Rection’s expectation of support.

chapters.title: Rection defeats both opponents
chapters.result: Rection beats Storm and Duggan in a handicap match to win the title.
chapters.context: Overcoming the numerical disadvantage supplies the championship payoff to the betrayal.
